title: Grouping beats
summary: Beats come in groups, and each group has a name.

steps.title: Bar
steps.body:
Beats fall into groups, usually of four: ONE two three four, ONE two three four. Each group is a **bar** (also called a **measure**). The first beat of each bar feels strongest.

**Why it matters:** Songs are counted in bars: "the verse is 8 bars", "change chord every bar". It is how a band knows where it is in a song.

steps.title: Count out loud
steps.body: Say "ONE two three four" as you tap, leaning on the ONE.

items.prompt: Tap one bar of four beats, counting out loud: 4 taps.
Tap two bars of four beats: 8 taps.

steps.title: Count a song
steps.body: Play a song and count "ONE two three four" along with it. Notice the chords often change on ONE.

items.prompt: Tap three bars of four beats: 12 taps.
